{{Quote|A former Imperial scientist was working in a bio-genetics lab on Talus. He was in charge of genetic experiments aiming to transform the goat-like murra from Corellia into an efficient all-terrain fighting animal. The resulting creature was named a kahmurra, though the Empire considered it a failure and cancelled all funding.|[[Yondalla]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Y" />}}
'''Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station''' was a bio-engineering laboratory located on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] where scientists created the [[kahmurra]] species.

==History==
{{Quote|I purchased a specially bred khmurra to guard my house. The bio-engineer I bought it from said he had a lab filled with resources that increased both their viciousness and their loyalty. Well, he was only half right. It killed my whole family|A commoner, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Ac">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|A commoner|Talus}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kahmurra_Biogenetic_Research_Station_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kahmurras in tanks.]]
The Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station was a bio-genetics laboratory founded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the planet Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. The objective of the research conducted in the lab was to develop an all-terrain hunting beast. Imperial scientists successfully generated a new animal species, the kahmurra, a genetically engineered creature derived from the goat-like [[Murra/Legends|murras]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. However, the Empire considered the project a failure and cancelled all funding. The research facility was officially closed<ref name="SWG:Y" /> and the kahmurra specimens then ran wild on Talus.<ref name="SWG:K">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Kahmurra|Talus}}</ref> Nevertheless, several bio-engineers continued to work in the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station.<ref name="SWG:KBRS" />

[[File:Kahmurra_Biogenetic_Research_Station_3.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A kahmurra under examination.]]

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a commoner living in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] bought a khmurra to a scientist working at the biogenetic research station in order to guard his house. However, the creature killed his whole family.<ref name="SWG:Ac" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] dispatched an assassin to eliminate the scientist leading the kahmurra project but the assassin failed in his mission and was captured in the bio-genetics laboratory. Jabba's lieutenant [[Yondalla]] later recruited a spacer to recover a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] prisoner transfer document in the Kahmurra Biogenetic Research Station.<ref name="SWG:Y" />
